Configuration¶

The tool reads settings from a file named tool.toml in the project root.

File format¶

Each table configures one subsystem.

[server]
port = 8080

Options¶

Options in the file override built-in defaults.

Environment¶

Note

Environment variables override the file.

Options¶

tool.load(path)¶

Load settings from path. See the specification.
